text_block_list.text:
At the year-end Grand Prix—the Arima

Kinen—standing at the top of all these
amazing
classic and senior racers is...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин! She's seized victory with
her
unprecedentedly powerful final
sprint!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Dear... Look at how strong you are. Look
how
strong you've become!
text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит hoists Нарита Таисин
atop her
shoulders—with Бива Хаяхидэ
lending a steady
hand on her back to
keep her from falling.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her head held higher than anyone
else's,
Нарита Таисин basks in the
thunderous applause
and booming
cheers that never seem to end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: You were the fastest of them all!
